newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose slightly on overseas demand at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
Brokers said buyers for Poland, Pakistan and Afghanistan lifted bulk of the brokens and fannings tea on offer.

More than 1.08 million kg of teas were sold at the auction. The average tea price was 44.35 taka, up 0.25 from the previous sale. The next auction will be held on October 17 with an offer of 1.17 million kg.
